Michael I. Wayne, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff, Consolidated Electrical Distributors, Inc., a Delaware corporation,

Damages: $8,154.11
Pre-Judgment Interest: $1,101.48
Attorney's Fees: $2,825.00
Costs: $964.80

Judgment signed in open court.
